# Engagements (web)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

Overview, adding an engagement, and Settings with one component per tab.

## Files

- `AddEngagementPage.vue`: Add an engagement (a new client or project) in six steps: Client, Scope, Gates, Tools (how the client works; v1.7.2), Models, Review.
- `EngagementAccess.vue`: Who can see this engagement: everyone signed in, or only its members (and admins).
- `OverviewPage.vue`: Overview: the engagement at a glance (coverage, high risks, what needs you, spend, recent runs).
- `SettingsAgentsTab.vue`: Settings > AI Agents: each stage's agent (and any added ones), its model, fallback, instructions, how it works, tools, limits and kill switch.
- `SettingsGatesTab.vue`: Settings > Approval gates: for each stage, which agent drafts and whether a named person acts before the use case moves on.
- `SettingsGeneralTab.vue`: Settings > General: the engagement's details and pause, its optional modules and the client steps default, and archiving, restoring or deleting it.
- `SettingsPage.vue`: Engagement settings.
- `SettingsToolsTab.vue`: Settings > Connected tools: the business tools this client uses, its connectors, pipeline tokens and write-back.

## Pages

| Address | Page |
|---|---|
| `/overview` | `OverviewPage.vue` |
| `/settings/:tab(general|workflow|integrations|agents|access)` | `SettingsPage.vue` |
| `/engagements/new` | `AddEngagementPage.vue` |

The server side is in [`apps/server/src/engagements`](../../../../server/src/engagements/README.md).
